rules.description: LLC must be selected before deal submission

rules.description: Florida Articles of Organization must be uploaded

rules.description: Authorized signer/managing member must be identified

rules.errorMessage: Client Services Agreement not executed
rules.remediation: Execute CSA via DocuSeal with authorized signer

rules.errorMessage: FAR/BAR AS-IS contract not uploaded

rules.errorMessage: OCR extraction failed - cannot validate FAR/BAR contract

rules.description: Buyer name must match selected LLC

validation.customLogic: const normalized = (ocrResult.buyerName || '').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const llcNorm = selectedLLC.legalName.toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return normalized.includes(llcNorm) || normalized.includes(llcNorm.replace(/,?\s*LLC$/, ''))

rules.errorMessage: Buyer name does not match selected LLC
rules.remediation: Verify FAR/BAR contract buyer matches LLC legal name exactly

rules.description: Seller name must match public records

validation.customLogic: const normalized = (ocrResult.sellerName || '').toUpperCase(); const publicNorm = (publicRecords.ownerName || '').toUpperCase(); return normalized.includes(publicNorm) || publicNorm.includes(normalized)

rules.errorMessage: Seller name may not match public records - manual review needed
rules.remediation: Verify seller is current owner via deed search

rules.errorMessage: Contract is not assignable - wholesale deals require assignment rights
rules.remediation: FAR/BAR contract must include 'and/or assigns' language or explicit assignment clause

rules.errorMessage: Missing AS-IS clause - required for Florida wholesale (FAR/BAR AS-IS contract)
rules.remediation: Must use FAR/BAR AS-IS Residential Contract for wholesale deals

rules.errorMessage: FAR/BAR contract closing date has passed
rules.remediation: Closing date must be in the future

rules.errorMessage: Seller signature not detected on FAR/BAR contract
rules.remediation: Contract must be signed by seller

rules.description: Inspection period recommended for wholesale deals
rules.errorMessage: No inspection period specified - recommended for wholesale (allows time to find buyer)
rules.remediation: Florida contracts typically include 10-15 day inspection period

validation.customLogic: if (property.hoaRequired || property.condoUnit) { return property.documents.some(d => d.category === 'hoa_disclosure'); } return true;

rules.errorMessage: Property in HOA/Condo - disclosure recommended (very common in Florida)
rules.remediation: Upload HOA/Condo disclosure if property is in association

rules.description: Must disclose not a licensed real estate agent
rules.errorMessage: Missing 'not a licensed agent' disclosure (Florida Statute §475)
rules.remediation: Florida requires disclosure if buyer is not a licensed real estate agent

rules.errorMessage: Missing 'acting as principal' disclosure
rules.remediation: Disclose that buyer is acting as principal, not as agent or broker

rules.description: Intent to assign must be disclosed
rules.errorMessage: Missing intent to assign disclosure (Florida consumer protection)
rules.remediation: Must disclose intent to assign contract to subsequent purchaser

rules.errorMessage: Missing assignment fee disclosure - HIGH RISK (Florida §501.204 Unfair Trade Practices)
rules.remediation: Florida consumer protection law requires assignment fee disclosure to seller

rules.errorMessage: Missing no performance guarantee disclosure
rules.remediation: Disclose that wholesaler makes no guarantee assignee will perform/close

rules.description: Seller advised to seek independent legal counsel
rules.errorMessage: Missing independent legal advice disclosure
rules.remediation: Advise seller to seek independent legal and financial counsel

validation.customLogic: const phase3Pass = compliance.phase3Status === 'GREEN'; const phase4Score = [compliance.disclosureNotLicensedAgent, compliance.disclosureActingPrincipal, compliance.disclosureIntentAssign, compliance.disclosureAssignmentFee, compliance.disclosureNoPerformanceGuarantee, compliance.disclosureIndependentAdvice].filter(d => d === true).length; return phase3Pass && phase4Score === 6 ? 'GREEN' : (phase4Score >= 4 ? 'YELLOW' : 'RED')

rules.errorMessage: Compliance score calculated
rules.remediation: Review compliance dashboard for details

rules.errorMessage: Cannot distribute with YELLOW or RED compliance status
rules.remediation: Fix compliance issues to achieve GREEN status before distribution

rules.description: MSA must be executed if distributing
rules.errorMessage: Cannot distribute without executed MSA
rules.remediation: Execute Marketing Services Agreement via DocuSeal

validation.customLogic: if (!distributionChannels.includes('auction')) return true; return property.agreements.some(a => a.agreementType === 'ASA' && a.status === 'executed')

rules.errorMessage: Cannot use auction channel without executed ASA
rules.remediation: Execute Auction Services Agreement

rules.errorMessage: Deal pending broker review
rules.remediation: Wait for broker approval

validation.customLogic: const review = property.reviews.find(r => r.reviewType === 'broker'); return review && review.decision === 'approved'

rules.errorMessage: Broker has not approved distribution
rules.remediation: Address broker's concerns and request re-review

rules.description: End buyer details must be provided
rules.errorMessage: End buyer information missing
rules.remediation: Provide end buyer/assignee contact details

rules.errorMessage: Florida assignment agreement not uploaded
rules.remediation: Upload executed Assignment of Contract and Purchase Rights

rules.description: Assignor name must match wholesaler LLC

validation.customLogic: const normalized = (ocrResult.assignorName || '').toUpperCase(); const llcNorm = selectedLLC.legalName.toUpperCase(); return normalized.includes(llcNorm)

rules.errorMessage: Assignor does not match wholesaler LLC
rules.remediation: Assignment must be from the LLC that holds the original FAR/BAR contract

rules.description: Assignment property must match original FAR/BAR contract

validation.customLogic: const assignAddr = (ocrResult.propertyAddress || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, ''); const origAddr = (property.address || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, ''); return assignAddr === origAddr

rules.errorMessage: Assignment property address does not match original FAR/BAR contract
rules.remediation: Property address on assignment must match purchase contract exactly

rules.errorMessage: Assignment fee not extracted - verify disclosure compliance
rules.remediation: Ensure assignment fee is clearly stated on assignment agreement

rules.errorMessage: Deposit/earnest money handling not specified
rules.remediation: Assignment should specify how deposit is handled (transferred, refunded, etc.)

extractionProfiles.name: Florida FAR/BAR AS-IS Contract
extractionProfiles.description: FAR/BAR AS-IS Residential Contract for Sale and Purchase
extractionProfiles.promptOverrides:
Extract fields from Florida FAR/BAR AS-IS Residential Contract.

Florida-specific notes:
- FAR/BAR standard form (Florida Association of Realtors / Florida Bar)
- AS-IS clause is critical for wholesale
- Look for inspection period (typically 10-15 days)
- Title evidence section (Florida uses specific title requirements)
- Deposit handling (initial and additional deposits)

Return JSON with extracted fields.

extractionProfiles.name: Florida Wholesale Disclosure (6-Point)
extractionProfiles.description: Florida wholesale assignment disclosure requirements (6 critical)
extractionProfiles.promptOverrides:
Extract disclosure checkboxes from Florida wholesale disclosure addendum.

Look for 6 CRITICAL Florida disclosures:
1. Not a licensed real estate agent (FL Statute §475)
2. Acting solely as principal
3. Intent to assign to subsequent purchaser
4. Assignment fee disclosure (FL §501.204 Consumer Protection)
5. No guarantee of assignee performance
6. Independent legal/financial advice

For each disclosure, return:
- Boolean: true if found, false if not
- Evidence: exact text snippet

Return JSON format.

extractionProfiles.name: Florida Assignment of Contract
extractionProfiles.description: Florida Assignment of Contract and Purchase Rights
extractionProfiles.promptOverrides:
Extract fields from Florida Assignment of Contract and Purchase Rights.

Key fields:
- Assignor (must match original FAR/BAR contract buyer)
- Assignee (new buyer)
- Property address (must match exactly)
- Assignment fee
- Deposit/earnest money handling (important in Florida)

Return JSON.
